vuln.name: Form Autocomplete Enabled on Sensitive Field
vuln.description: A form containing a password, credit card, or other sensitive input has the autocomplete attribute enabled (or unset, the default), allowing the browser to cache and suggest the value on this and other sites.
vuln.impact: Sensitive values may be stored by the browser and leaked to other users of the device or to malware with browser data access.
vuln.recommendation: Set autocomplete="off" (or a more specific off token like new-password / cc-number) on sensitive input fields.
